item.title: Console UI Authentication Degraded [resolved]
item.description:
Access to the Axiom Console through Github is available as well as all other authentication methods.
Users might experience a one-time email verification step for their Primary Github email. The Primary email address should be configured as the email used with an Axiom account. Additional verified emails can be used to access separate Axiom accounts.

The root cause has also been identified and we are actively working on it so queries are not affected again.

item.title: Email notifications delayed for Legacy EU monitors [resolved]
item.description:
Between March 30 and April 13, a configuration issue prevented email notifications from firing for monitors on our Legacy EU infrastructure (not EU edge deployment). Monitor evaluation was functioning correctly during this period — monitors were being evaluated and other notification channels were unaffected — but email delivery through our email provider was misconfigured for the EU region.
The issue has been resolved. Email notifications are now firing correctly for all EU monitors. If you believe you missed critical email alerts during this window, we recommend reviewing your monitor history in the Axiom dashboard.
We apologize for the disruption and are putting safeguards in place to prevent similar issues in the future.

item.title: EU Monitor Processing failures [resolved]
item.description:
We have identified and resolved issues with monitor processing in the EU region
Some of our EU customers could have experienced monitor processing issues.
During this period, gaps in alerting were a possibility due to instability issues caused by underlying scaling issues. Monitoring systems in other regions remained operational.
The issue was identified and resolved on Sunday evening, and all monitoring services in the EU region have since been fully restored.
To prevent similar issues in the future, we have added automated configuration validation, expanded deployment checks for regional dependencies, and introduced enhanced monitoring of our monitoring layer itself.
